summary: One-frame request from the throw spell preview to attach the object being thrown (a preview dummy) to an entity: two entity handles, two flags (both written 1) and a FixedString (attachment point). Written by the spell preview code bg3.exe+0x1F51980; read by ecl::thrown::AttachmentSystem (macOS Update / GatherDetachmentRequests). Shape close to the request behind eoc::thrown::AttachComponent (entity, bools, FixedString). Never seen alive. Registry total 24 (client row).

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1F52DC0 (AllocRaw 0x18) writes 0xFFC0000000000000 (null handle). Writer bg3.exe+0x1F51980 stores `*(u64*)(*value + 8)` of an entry of the preview's entity map (param_9) - an entity handle (probably the thrown object / preview dummy).

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: Creator writes the null handle at +8. Writer stores piVar36 (checked as a valid handle: index < 0x41 and != null) in one branch, or the entity at +0x40/+0x48 of another object (choice by its byte +0x50) in the other - the entity to attach to.

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: Creator writes uint16 0 at +0x10; writer always stores the uint16 0x101 -> bytes +0x10 and +0x11 both 1.

fields.name: field_11
fields.evidence: Second byte of the 0x101 store (see field_10).

fields.name: _Pad12
fields.evidence: alignment of the FixedString at +0x14; not written.

fields.name: field_14
fields.evidence: Creator writes 0xFFFFFFFF; destructor bg3.exe+0x6BD390 DecRefs +0x14. Writer assigns (IncRef/DecRef) a FixedString from bg3.exe+0x1F6F020: the FixedString at +8 of a component of the target entity (FUN_140f24fc0), or of the preview's attachment data (+0x90) - probably the attachment bone, like eoc::thrown::AttachComponent.field_C.

open_questions: Which entity is which (thrown object vs. attach target) and what the two flags mean; the macOS reader AttachmentSystem has no Toolkit version to name them.
Not seen alive (seen.py has no samples).
